RBD,DBR

SUPPLY AND DEMAND

I intend to continue my trading journey here . I will be starting what

Before we begin I would like to emphasize that I am a novice and this is
 just what I've seen in this two month. So all the topics that I write
can be misleading. But all my efforts is that I can prove things to
myself. I thank all those who have helped me in understanding. And at
the end, I apologize for the lack of English language.

Salivan

First, I will address several questions.

1-What is the market?

2-Who will drive the market ?

3-What is their purpose?

4-Why RTM ?

5- What are our weapons ?

6-How a tool works?

7-Why it works?

Now I try to answer these questions in my point of view .

1-What is the market ?

I think the market is a jungle .there are the number of bull ,the bears,
 the dogs, the lambs and the pigs in this jungle that they fight to each
 other's.

2-who will drive the Market ?

In my idea the dogs .they called them Big Boys , Smart Money , IT s .

Dogs are loyal to their commitments. And I think all the things that one
 need in this jungle is loyalty to its commitments. So that They
eventually wins.

3-what is their purpose ?

What are their obligations ? They need to empty the pockets of others either bulls or bears .

4- why RTM ?

For me , because RTM showed me in what areas ,the moderator of this
jungle is waiting for it's prey to hunt them and it is not important if
they are bear or bull or lamb or pigs. Here, kill or be killed.

5-What are our weapons ?

There are a lot of armaments in this castle.

SUPPLY & DEMAND,RBD,DBR,CP,ENGULF,FO,3DERIVE,QUASIMODO,CAN-CAN,FLAGS and some others.

6-How a tool works ?

In the videos, Mr. IF has told us how a tool works and how we can use them,

also the masters wrote some articles for us, that I call all this collection, the art of war .

7-why it works ?

This is the most important part .because the I think it's more important why a tool work that what it works .

So that I start with RBD,DBR s.

What is RBD ,DBR ???

RALLY BASE DROP :

Generally We call it supply . it's The resistance against rising
prices.it Contains the worst buyers and also some decision points that
sellers exceeds buyers . so that if any decision made there that price
is too expensive we expect in future the big boys can grab some orders
from unsuspecting traders or the worst buyers here again . so that this
zone is full of DPs. I think all the market are DP s.in this case Some
decisions have been taken to reduce the price . but why they think price
 is here too expensive ??

Psychologically, people tend to repeat their decisions in life the
decisions that altered the course of prices in general are important to
us. So that if the price is reduced with these decisions we call this
area that the decision have been made in it, supply (RBD).and the same
applies to regional demand(DBR).some decision have been taken that price
 is too cheap so the big boys can grab some orders from the novice
traders like me in that area in future again.in this case some decision
have been taken to rally the price and support it.so This set of
decisions in that area, that the price is cheap cause a DBR for us that
we call it DEMAND area .

But the quality of development of these areas are important to us. How
and in what form they are formed is very important. Do they have a firm
decision or indecision has occurred in past ??these are also important .
 Another issue is approaching the prices to these areas.so that if price
 approaching to a fresh area as a compression we can expect that area to
 work again as before. But if price approaching the area Strictly we
should wait and use other weapons .

I think all the market is fear and greed. Those CPs represents the fear.
 And high volatility is indicate the greed . so that in greed we should
pay more attention to other weapons why the opponent does not fear
losing and very assertive in approaching our privacy. our privacy is our
 castle , where we already have seen fighters failure. If you look into
the real world you will see that the losers always fear at The places
where they have failed there . So this is a psychological reason. This
forest is a mirror of the behavior of its residents.

After a number of failed raid to break up the castle If they want to
break the barrier must gather more power so they go down to
reinvigoratewe, call it deep pullbacks. This is what we see in the real
world. Castle also been hitting so that it's too weak for the next
attack and we call this consumptions of the orders. Weakness or strength
 of the castle can be determined from something that we call it SUPPLY
& DEMAND. I want to say that I see the difference between SUPPLY
with RBD and DEMAND with DBR . I will explain the reason, In future.
Therefore the more attacking to a castle cause it weaker and in the next
 raid, it may be rejected by the stronger amount of attackers.

This how I read the story .

After that we have some other weapons to determine whether a castle resistance against the attacks or not ?

Something that called CP. Compression is a kind of fear. But sometimes
this is fear that gives courage. My fear is what gives me the courage.
Again, these two issues are related to underpin our castle .A new castle
 usually resistance against the fear of the attackers .

Retreat or recess of warriors in the way up toapproaching the castle is a
 sign that they fear . After reaching the Castle The first warrior who
fail ,break the morale of the fighters . On the other hand if the army
on the way forward reach to a coward Front ,Of course, it will be faster
 to defeat it .

now what is the difference between SUPPLY and RBD ?

Imagine we want to build a fortress. a fortress which contains many
castle that Each castle has a flag . in my idea even a strong fortress
on a loose ground cannot withstand the attacks .so that I consider
supply as a ground as the foundation of the fortress and consider the
fortress as RBD. vice versa for DEMAND and DBR too. In the RBD the upper
 castle in this case the extreme edge of the fortress is SUPPLY area
that resistance against the Attackers.

The question that must be asked here is that Why this Classifications are important for me ?

If attackers can infiltrate a castle after a while they vivify their
power then march in the same direction of the seepage to approach
another castle on their way . how much to be returning to shore power
depends on the strength of the fortress collapsed, that RTM call it as
ENGULF .

I have another question:

Who make this ENGULF ?

No one in particular , The only things that make penetration occurs are
the fort foundation strength and the strength of the invaders blows.

The question is whether the big boy makes an engulf or all attackers make it?

Or do engulf pre-made and big boy sees it and then decide for it ?

This question also are right and logical .

In my idea all these issues together, provides the ENGULF :

A.

The weakness of the land on which the castle was established on it . In
 this case SUPPLY & DEMAND (Combination of fortresses that collapsed
 earlier)

B.

Amount of fresh attackers and how long it takes to accumulating fresh power to continue their way .

C.

BIG BOYS (heroes) are also analysis the war and novices are do it too .

I will try to prove and also improve this story .in the next part of this article I will try to anatomize the topic engulf .

END OF PART 1.

Any comments would be really appreciated

THE ART OF WAR

PART2

In the previous section PART 1 I tried to tell clip of a battle.

A war in which fighters are trying to conquer the castles in the air.
Decisions should be taken to conquer a castle. Places where decisions
are taken are important for us. The think tanks! If you want to destroy a
 castle ,at first penetrate to the think tanks .

Before conquering a castle it should be breached. We as a trader there
is no matter if a fortress conquered by bulls or bears . We're just
looking to make a profit in this war and wherever a permeation occurs we
 accompany the fighters. So we want to be loyal to our rules, not the
rules of the war. In the meantime, there are signs to those who deal
with THE RTM ART OF WAR.

WHAT IS AN ENGULF ?

The most important question in RTM training camp. First of all I want to describe a hypothetical battle.

Suppose that an army is advancing to conquer the enemy positions. Enemy
positions include a number of castles that formed a fortress. To conquer
 a fortress its FLAG should be conquer. As soon as the flag of first
castle was removed we must ask ourselves a few questions.

1-

What is the position of the conquered castle?

2-

Where they come from and where are they now?

3-

Is there a nearby castle, which is already under attack?

4-

After the conquest of the castle and down the old flag, did the attackers have raised their flag?

5-

Where is the nearest room to think and also where is next think tank that should be conquered?

Answer all these questions will help us to be able to properly read the
map. And all this story is only to know that, the forces after pulling
down the enemy's flag ,retreat to rest and gather strength again to
reach the goal. The aim is to flag down the next summit.

Therefore , THE ENGULF is a sign that tell us in advance there is a goal that has not been realized.

In next part I try to make some images from the different battlefield.

END OF PART 2

WITH REGARDS

 SALIVAN
